description:
Sixth phase of bl-7c23. Final cleanup pass.

=== Scope ===

1. Run 'make schemas' (or equivalent) and commit the regenerated schemas/*.json. Verify each matches the post-redesign config types: manifest.json, providers.json (per-repo shape with roles:), workflow.json, version.json. Delete schemas/agents.json. Add schemas/global-providers.json for the harness-root file if it isn't already there.
2. grep -rn '\.agent/\|exchanges/\|invocations/\|ex/<\|inv/<\|agents\.yaml' src/ crates/ template/ tests/ README.md AGENTS.md and clean up any current-state references. Historical references in ARCH §12 milestones (v0.1, v0.2 shipped shapes) stay; everything else goes.
3. Update README.md: install instructions, quickstart now use the new layout. Show the harness root + conversation repo distinction.
4. Update AGENTS.md (project-level) if any contributor flow changed.
5. Run 'cargo clippy -D warnings' and 'cargo fmt --check' on the whole workspace; fix anything the redesign introduced.

=== Constraints ===

- This is intended to be a small-diff cleanup ball. If a sweep finds a real semantic gap (something the earlier phases missed), file a separate ball under the epic and continue with the strict cleanup work here.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: Phase 6: schema regen + final string sweep
